title: Pedunculoside ameliorates liver fibrosis by targeting c-Jun to inhibit hepatic stellate cell activation.
authors: Wang, Ao; Dong, Hui; Cui, Yaqian; Jin, Yiqian; Xiong, Yongqiang; Jin, Leiming; Zhang, Qianhui; Zhu, Weiwei; Ye, Jiaxi; Lin, Mengsha; Luo, Wu; Liang, Guang; Sun, Jinfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物PED通过靶向c-Jun抑制肝星状细胞活化改善肝纤维化，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟预测蛋白-小分子结合，但核心对象是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver fibrosis represents a critical stage in the progression of chronic liver diseases and is characterized by the activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs). Pedunculoside (PED), a pentacyclic triterpenoid saponin derived from Ilex rotunda Thunb, has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and organ-protective effects in the heart and lungs. However, its therapeutic potential and direct molecular targets in the context of liver fibrosis remain unknown. METHODS: The antifibrotic effects of PED were assessed using TGF-beta1-activated LX-2 cells and two murine models of liver fibrosis induced by carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4)) and bile duct ligation (BDL). Transcriptomic sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed to map the signaling alterations induced by PED. An integrated strategy, combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, was employed to predict potential targets. The direct interaction between PED and its target was validated via cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA) and Sepharose pull-down assays. Gain-of-function and loss-of-function experiments were conducted to confirm the target-dependent mechanism of PED. RESULTS: PED treatment significantly inhibited HSC proliferation and activation in vitro and attenuated hepatic fibrogenesis and collagen deposition in both CCl(4)- and BDL-induced mouse models. Transcriptomic profiling revealed that PED broadly suppressed fibrogenic signaling cascades, including the MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways. Notably, c-Jun was identified as a direct binding target of PED. Biophysical assays confirmed that PED binds to the pocket of c-Jun, thereby blocking its phosphorylation and transcriptional activity. Furthermore, overexpression of c-Jun abolished the antifibrotic effects of PED in HSCs, while loss-of-function experiments revealed that c-Jun knockdown mimicked the inhibitory effects of PED on TGF-beta1-induced HSC activation and proliferation, with no significant additive antifibrotic effect observed when PED was administered to c-Jun-silenced HSCs. confirming that the PED-c-Jun axis is the primary mechanism of action. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that PED is a potent antifibrotic agent that functions by directly targeting and inhibiting c-Jun. This study provides the first evidence for the pharmacological modulation of c-Jun by PED, with rigorous gain- and loss-of-function validation of the target dependency, highlighting its potential as a novel therapeutic strategy for the treatment of liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化是慢性肝病进展中的关键阶段，其特征为肝星状细胞（HSCs）的激活。铁冬青酸（Pedunculoside, PED），一种源自铁冬青（Ilex rotunda Thunb）的五环三萜皂苷，已被报道在心脏和肺中表现出抗炎、抗氧化及器官保护作用。然而，其在肝纤维化背景下的治疗潜力和直接分子靶点仍未知。方法：使用TGF-β1激活的LX-2细胞以及由四氯化碳（CCl(4)）和胆管结扎（BDL）诱导的两种小鼠肝纤维化模型，评估PED的抗纤维化效果。通过转录组测序（RNA-seq）绘制PED诱导的信号改变图谱。采用整合策略，结合网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，预测潜在靶点。通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和Sepharose pull-down实验验证PED与其靶点之间的直接相互作用。进行功能获得和功能丧失实验，以确认PED的靶点依赖性机制。结果：PED处理在体外显著抑制HSC增殖和激活，并在CCl(4)-和BDL诱导的小鼠模型中减轻肝纤维化生成和胶原沉积。转录组分析显示，PED广泛抑制纤维化信号级联，包括MAPK和NF-κB通路。值得注意的是，c-Jun被鉴定为PED的直接结合靶点。生物物理实验确认PED结合至c-Jun的袋状结构，从而阻断其磷酸化和转录活性。此外，c-Jun的过表达消除了PED在HSC中的抗纤维化效果，而功能丧失实验显示，c-Jun敲低模拟了PED对TGF-β1诱导的HSC激活和增殖的抑制作用，且在c-Jun沉默的HSC中施用PED未观察到显著的附加抗纤维化效果，确认PED-c-Jun轴是主要作用机制。结论：我们的发现表明，PED是一种有效的抗纤维化剂，通过直接靶向并抑制c-Jun发挥作用。本研究首次提供了PED对c-Jun药理学调节的证据，并通过严格的功能获得和丧失验证了靶点依赖性，突显其作为治疗肝纤维化新策略的潜力。
